items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I figured I wasn't going to be with Charlie Cook all my life... I would see Charlie Cook on Broadway every now and then see, and we'd talk about it

ctx.x: Well when you get to Chicago now then you got the three month lay off with the union. And we've got that about the Roulette band. Now what happens when you get with Doc Cook?

Well Doc Cook, he wanted us to join his band you know? He came out to listen to us and everything. And he liked the way I played and everything. But he wanted me to get a bass drum, an old time bass drum that was so deep you know, a twenty, say a twenty eight by sixteen or seventeen or something like that. But he liked that bass drum. And he wanted plenty of volume for that bass drum.

So I told him, I said, man, I've got a brand new set of (proto?) drums. I just had gotten them you know. And I told him that I…
